# IRoundsVaultRegistryErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultRegistryErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultRegistryErrors

Custom errors for the RoundsVaultRegistry.


## Errors
### PairAlreadyExists
Reverts when registering a pair whose target vault is already registered.


```solidity
error PairAlreadyExists(bytes32 pairId);
```

### PairNotFound
Reverts when reading/updating a pair that does not exist.


```solidity
error PairNotFound(bytes32 pairId);
```

### NoVaultProvided
Reverts when neither inputVault nor outputVault is provided (at least one must be set).


```solidity
error NoVaultProvided();
```

### TargetVaultZero
Reverts when targetVault is the zero address.


```solidity
error TargetVaultZero();
```

### TargetMismatch
Reverts when an input/output vault's `vault()` view does not match the declared target.


```solidity
error TargetMismatch(address vaultAddr, address expected, address actual);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vaultAddr`|`address`| The rounds-vault that failed validation|
|`expected`|`address`|  Declared target vault|
|`actual`|`address`|    The address returned by `IRoundsVaultBase(vaultAddr).vault()`|

### PairStateUnchanged
Reverts when reactivating a pair that is already active or deactivating one that is already inactive.


```solidity
error PairStateUnchanged(bytes32 pairId);
```

### UpdateWouldEmptyPair
Reverts when an update would leave the pair with neither input nor output vault set.


```solidity
error UpdateWouldEmptyPair(bytes32 pairId);
```

### VaultFlavorMismatch
Reverts when a provided rounds-vault's VAULT_TYPE does not match the slot it is being assigned to.


```solidity
error VaultFlavorMismatch(
    address vaultAddr, IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.BaseVaultType expected, IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.BaseVaultType actual
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vaultAddr`|`address`|The misclassified vault.|
|`expected`|`IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.BaseVaultType`| The flavor required by the slot (Input or Output).|
|`actual`|`IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.BaseVaultType`|   The flavor returned by the vault's `VAULT_TYPE()`.|

### UseClearInsteadOfZero
Reverts when a `setInputVault` / `setOutputVault` call is passed `address(0)`.

The API forbids using a zero address as a "clear" sentinel — callers must use
`clearInputVault` / `clearOutputVault` to drop a side.


```solidity
error UseClearInsteadOfZero(bytes32 pairId);
```
